thread:
evan: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from last night's DB cascade. Need to lock down customer-facing language + decide RCA sharing approach. Can we land owners and deadlines by EOD?

maria-p: I can draft the status update. I'll include impact numbers and a short mitigation timeline. Will need a quick legal pass.

sachin: I'll take point on the RCA-sharing policy recommendation. Initial idea: default = 'RCA available on request', public RCA only for Sev1s after internal review. Will draft pros/cons.

ops-bot: Incident #INC-2026-03-22-DBCASCADE — final state: services restored 02:12 UTC, degraded for ~47m, root cause in cross-region failover path. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-03-22-DBCASCADE

devx: recurring note — this is our 3rd similar failover-related outage in 7 months. For the status page, can we add a short line about 'mitigations in progress' to set expectation about follow-ups?

maria-p: good call. Draft will have a 1-paragraph summary + 2 bullets: impact & mitigations in progress. Will tag legal for redaction check.

legal-sw: happy to review. For customer-facing summaries, avoid internal configs/names and any PII. For RCA sharing: recommend a redaction checklist and a simple consent flow for named enterprise customers.

anya: FYI: support already flagged 12 customers for proactive outreach. We should coordinate exact wording so outreach aligns with status page.

evan: Proposed owners & deadlines: 1) Status draft — maria-p — by 18:00 UTC today. 2) Legal redaction review — legal-sw — by 20:00 UTC. 3) RCA policy draft — sachin — by tomorrow 12:00 UTC. 4) Outreach list & copy — anya + support — by 19:00 UTC. Please ack.

maria-p: ack, will post PR to /docs/statuspage so ops-sre can preview.

sachin: ack. I'll include two options: (A) default 'on request' with redaction, (B) publish after 72h for Sev1.

legal-sw: ack. I'll add a short NDAs-consideration note and sample redaction checklist.

devx: tiny suggestion for status wording: include "what we're doing next" + ETA window (not specific times) — reduces follow-up pings.

evan: good. Also want to track this as a recurring-pattern remediation item in the postmortem action tracker. Assign an owner to the longer-term pattern review?

anya: I can own the recurring-pattern ticket; will set up a biweekly sync with infra + runtime to dig into failover logic. Target: initial investigation summary in 2 weeks.

evan: perfect. I'll add these as action items in the postmortem doc and ping product for prioritization. Final checklist (copying into thread so it's visible):
- maria-p: Draft status page copy by 18:00 UTC ✅
- legal-sw: Redaction/consent review by 20:00 UTC ✅
- anya + support: Customer outreach list & copy by 19:00 UTC ✅
- sachin: RCA-sharing policy draft by 12:00 UTC tomorrow ✅
- anya: Recurring-pattern investigation owner, initial summary in 2 weeks ✅

sachin: Extra note on policy — include an explicit step for 'customer opts-in to receive full RCA' and a template request flow. I'll paste a short sample in the policy doc.

maria-p: I'll put the status draft in a PR and ping #eng oncall for technical accuracy before posting.

evan: Thanks all. If anyone can't meet the deadlines, flag here immediately. Otherwise we'll reconvene after PR/legal pass. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: 1) add action items to postmortem tracker 2) mark customer outreach as high priority 3) schedule follow-up sync in calendar (invites from anya).
